verdict.rationale: For a hardware key, the relevant data is credential and pairing state. The docs cover only glancing deletion controls: you can remove the key from your Google Account (docs-9), reset a Bluetooth key, although the registration persists afterward (docs-8), and unpair it from all Bluetooth devices (docs-19/23). Missing for 10: documented wiping of on-key credentials or passkeys, any data-retention policy or controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
